text.en: A letter? Nobody writes to me. Give it here.
text.id: Surat? Tak ada yang menulis untukku. Sini.

text.en: Brann reads it twice. Then he sits down on the edge of the well.
text.id: Brann membacanya dua kali. Lalu ia duduk di tepi sumur.

text.en: Tamsin Oller. Took an arrow at the ford and complained about it for a month. He farms sheep past the north ridge now. Alive, and fat.
text.id: Tamsin Oller. Kena panah di arungan dan mengeluh sebulan penuh. Sekarang beternak domba di balik punggung bukit utara. Masih hidup, dan gendut.

text.en: Tell his sister that. Tell her he never learned to write, or she would have heard from him years ago.
text.id: Katakan itu pada kakaknya. Katakan dia tak pernah belajar menulis, kalau tidak dia pasti sudah mengabari bertahun-tahun lalu.
